description: F1a COP map + part-load ratio curve (cycling losses below PLR 0.3) + water flow rate effect on evaporator U_A. Defrost not applicable (water side).

unit.name: Generic 50kW Water-Source Heat Pump (R410A)
unit.source: ASHRAE Handbook HVAC Systems and Equipment (2020) Ch. 9; EN 14511; Bagarella et al. (2016) Applied Thermal Engineering 103:10-21

carnot_fraction.note: eta_Carnot = COP / COP_Carnot; 0.45-0.55 typical for WSHP

C_d.note: Degradation coefficient PLF = 1 - C_d*(1-PLR); WSHPs have lower C_d than ASHPs (~0.15 vs 0.25) due to more stable source temp

PLR_min.note: Minimum modulation ratio; below this on/off cycling begins

cycling_loss_factor.note: Additional COP penalty fraction per unit PLR below PLR_min

startup_penalty_kw.note: Electrical startup transient penalty during cycling

UA_rated.note: Evaporator overall heat transfer coefficient * area at rated water flow

flow_rate_rated.note: Rated water flow rate on source side

flow_rate_exponent.note: U_A ~ flow^n with n=0.8 for turbulent forced convection (Dittus-Boelter)
